clauses.title: Scope – Requirement of prelaminated particle
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirement of prelaminated particle boards for general purpose and also for special applications.

clauses.title: Grades and Types
clauses.text: 2. Grades and Types—Prelaminated particle boards shall be of two  grades, namely, Grade I and Grade II corresponding to IS  3087 : 1985+.

clauses.title: Each of the grades
clauses.text: 2.1 Each of the grades shall be of four types, namely, Type I, II, III and IV. Classified by surface abrasion characteristics  specified in Table 1.

clauses.title: The grades and types
clauses.text: 2.2 The grades and types shall represented by the symbols. Grade and Type Designation Grade I - Type I PLB-11 Type II PLB-12 Type III PLB-13 Type IV PLB-14 Grade II- Type I PLB-21 Type II PLB-22 Type III PLB-23 Type IV PLB-24

clauses.title: Particle Board
clauses.text: 3.1 Particle Board  -  Synthetic resin bonded flat pressed three layer or multi-layer or graded particle boards   conforming to IS 3087 : 1985+ shall be used.

clauses.title: Impregnated Base Paper
clauses.text: 3.2 Impregnated Base Paper — Printed or plain coloured absorbent base paper having a weight of 60- 140 g/m2 impregnated in a suitable synthetic resin and dried to a volatile content of 4-8 percent shall be used. SUMMARY OF IS 12823 : 1990 WOOD PRODUCTS-PRELAMINATED PARTICLES BOARDS

clauses.title: Impregnated Overlay
clauses.text: 3.3 Impregnated Overlay—An absorbent tissue paper having a weight of 18-40 g/m2 impregnated in a suitable synthetic resin and dried to a volatile content of 4-8 percent.

clauses.title: Finish
clauses.text: 4. Finish —The finish of the paper overlaid board depends on the surface of caul plates used.

clauses.title: Dimensions and Tolerances
clauses.text: 5. Dimensions and Tolerances —Dimensions and tolerances shall conform to IS 12049:1987.*

clauses.title: Resistance to Steam –
clauses.text: 6.3 Resistance to Steam - Shall not show any sign of blister, delamination or change in surface finish. There may be slight colour change in dark colours/ patterns.

clauses.title: Crack Resistance – Shall
clauses.text: 6.4 Crack Resistance - Shall not show any sign of cracks or delamination.

clauses.title: Resistance to digarette Burn
clauses.text: 6.5 Resistance to digarette Burn — shall not leave any mark or stain on the specimen after cleaning with water or solvent.

clauses.title: Resistance to Stain
clauses.text: 6.6 Resistance to Stain — Shall not leave any stain on the specimen after cleaning with  water, solvent or detergent.
